hadith:
Actions while Praying - Narrated Anas:

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whenever anyone of you is in prayer, he is speaking in private to his Lord and so he should neither spit in front of him nor on his right side but to his left side under his left foot."
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Muqeet - المُقيِت - The Sustainer

The name Al Muqeet comes from the Arabic root 'q-t', which relates to provision and sustenance. It reflects Allah's capacity to care for and nourish all beings, ensuring they receive what they need to survive and thrive, both physically and spiritually. This name emphasizes divine mercy and support.
verse:
Al-Hajj - The Pilgrimage - 22:77

O believers! Bow down, prostrate yourselves, worship your Lord, and do ˹what is˺ good so that you may be successful.
